title: Tips on cutting down on alcohol

sections.heading: Simple tips for cutting down
sections.text: Before you start drinking, set a limit on how much you're going to drink.

sections.heading: Simple tips for cutting down
sections.text: Only take a fixed amount of money to spend on alcohol.

sections.heading: Simple tips for cutting down
sections.text: If you let your friends and family know you're cutting down and it's important to you, you could get support from them.

sections.heading: Simple tips for cutting down
sections.sub: Take it a day at a time
sections.text: Cut back a little each day. That way, every day you do is a success.

sections.heading: Simple tips for cutting down
sections.text: You can still enjoy a drink, but go for smaller sizes. Try bottled beer instead of pints, or a small glass of wine instead of a large one.

sections.heading: Simple tips for cutting down
sections.text: Cut down the alcohol by swapping strong beers or wines for ones with a lower strength (ABV in %). You'll find this information on the bottle.

sections.heading: Simple tips for cutting down
sections.text: Try to have something to eat, and drink a glass of water, before you have alcohol. Alternate alcoholic drinks with water or other non-alcoholic drinks.

sections.heading: Benefits of cutting down
sections.text:
The immediate effects of cutting down on alcohol include:

- feeling better in the mornings
- being less tired during the day
- better-looking skin
- feeling more energetic
- better weight management
There are also many long-term benefits.

sections.heading: Benefits of cutting down
sections.text:
Cutting down can help lower your risk of serious conditions linked to drinking too much alcohol, such as:

- cancer
- diabetes
- dementia
- stroke
- heart, liver and kidney problems

sections.heading: Benefits of cutting down
sections.text: There's a strong link between heavy drinking and depression, and hangovers often make you feel anxious and low. If you already feel anxious or sad, drinking can make this worse, so cutting down may put you in a better mood generally.

sections.heading: Benefits of cutting down
sections.text: Drinking can affect your sleep. Although it can help some people fall asleep quickly, it can disrupt your sleep patterns and stop you sleeping deeply. So cutting down on alcohol should help you feel more rested when you wake up.

sections.heading: Benefits of cutting down
sections.text: Drinking can affect your judgement and behaviour. You may behave irrationally or aggressively when you're drunk, or make decisions you regret. Memory loss can be a problem during drinking and in the long term for regular heavy drinkers.

sections.heading: Benefits of cutting down
sections.text: Regular drinking can affect your body's ability to fight infections. Heavy drinkers tend to catch more infectious diseases.

sections.heading: Take the healthy choices quiz
sections.text: If you want to improve your health and wellbeing but are not sure where to start, the Healthy Choices quiz on the NHS Better Health website can give you personalised advice about how to live a healthier life.
